article.title: Rockets face the Hawks on 3-game win streak
article.linkText: Rockets face the Hawks on 3-game win streak
article.story: Atlanta Hawks (2-1, fourth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Houston Rockets (3-0, first in the Western Conference) Houston; Monday, 8:30 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Houston is looking to keep its three-game win streak going when the Rockets take on Atlanta. Houston finished 52-30 overall a season ago while going 30-11 at home. The Rockets averaged 115.2 points per game last season, 53.0 in the paint, 17.1 off of turnovers and 14.0 on fast breaks. Atlanta went 46-36 overall, 27-25 in Eastern Conference action and 22-19 on the road a season ago. The Hawks shot 47.4% from the field and 37.1% from 3-point range last season. The teams meet for the second time this season. The Rockets won 121-114 in the last matchup on Oct. 25. INJURIES: Rockets: Marcus Smart: out (forearm), Fred VanVleet: out (rest), Steven Adams: out (rest). Hawks: Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
